title: Black Bullet
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a near future where humanity has lost a war against the parasitic Gastrea virus, people live behind protective monoliths. Rentaro works for a civil security agency with Enju, one of the 'Cursed Children', girls infected in the womb who gain superhuman powers, and they fight Gastrea while a terrorist threatens Tokyo.
life_message: It suggests protecting others, including those society fears and rejects, even in a world close to despair.

content.note: Gun and monster combat in an action series (ICv2 review; MU Violence, Human Weapon; AniList Guns).
Humanity 'lives in despair'; horror and tragedy tags (Yen Press blurb; MangaDex Horror, Tragedy; MU Dark Ambience).
MU and MangaDex list Romance; the partners are young girls; how this is depicted is not described (to verify).
Discrimination against infected children and human experiments (MU Discrimination, Human Experiment/s; to verify).
Adaptation of a light-novel franchise with an anime.
